targetRuntime.note: The cartoon example is currently silent; this file is the timed dialogue plan for creating voice clips in ElevenLabs and aligning them in an audio timeline.

productionNotes: Generate each cue as its own clean dialogue clip so each speaker can use a consistent voice.
Do not add music or sound effects to the dialogue clips; mix ambience, music and effects on separate tracks.
The start and end values are timeline targets, not a promise that generated speech will fit perfectly without adjustment. Retiming or small edits may be needed after voice generation.
Leave room tone or silence at the end of clips rather than cutting consonants. Keep all final audio inside the 60-second master.

NARRATOR.direction: Warm, gentle storybook narration; clear articulation, intimate and calm; wonder increases as the fireflies gather.

LUMI.direction: Kind, curious, bright character voice; playful but never exaggerated; soft warmth in the final line.

FIREFLY.direction: Small, lively, slightly breathless character voice; starts worried, then grows excited and relieved.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: At twilight, Lumi spotted a lonely little light trembling in the grass.

cues.speaker: LUMI
cues.text: Hey, little glow. Why are you all alone?

cues.speaker: FIREFLY
cues.text: I lost my family. My light is too tiny!

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Lumi folded a broad leaf around a shining drop of dew, making a tiny lantern.

cues.speaker: LUMI
cues.text: We'll follow the creek. Stay close to my lantern!

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: They hopped from stone to stone while the water painted silver stars.

cues.speaker: FIREFLY
cues.text: That old willow! My family gathers there!

cues.speaker: LUMI
cues.text: Then let's make the darkest path sparkle!

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: One firefly answered, then ten, then a thousand tiny lights filled the clearing.

cues.speaker: FIREFLY
cues.text: You found them! Thank you, Lumi!
